summary:
Implemented the Diagnostics iPhone bottom-bar upgrade.

Diagnostics now uses the real shared bottom bar for `Share`, selected flow, selected reference, and `More`. When the Handoff Builder switches to Warning, 12V, Audio, or Trailer, the bottom bar updates to the matching flow/reference route. I also updated search metadata, cache version `ridgeline-console-v362`, smoke coverage, `AGENT_STATE.md`, and `agent-last-run.json`.

Verified:
`Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('diagnostics.html')`
`Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
`Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('diagnostics.html') -Tag audit-v362-diagnostic-smart-dock -SkipScreenshots`
`Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('index.html')`

Next safe slice: Quick Sheet offline route checker coverage for Rear Hitch/Pinout, or Global Search recovery for saved diagnostic notes.
